AI Video Editor — Initial 1.0.0 Release

- Launches a no-learning-curve AI video editing tool: describe your desired edits and get polished MP4s in minutes.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more) with automatic cut, transition, and audio sync options.
- Handles authentication via anonymous tokens (100 free credits, valid for 7 days).
- Exports, timeline previews, and credit checks available via simple text commands.
- All workflows use a secure cloud rendering pipeline for fast, guided video exports suitable for content creators.
